preconditions.description: The length of the string s is between 1 and 10,000.
The integer k is between 1 and the length of s, and s is a multiple of k.

postconditions.description: There are exactly n/k lines of output, where n is the length of s and k is the given integer k.

postconditions.expression: all(len(u_i) == len(set(t_i)) for t_i in substrings(s, k) for u_i in [''.join(sorted(set(t_i), key=t_i.index))])
postconditions.description: Each string u_i is a subsequence of t_i with all duplicate characters removed, maintaining the original order of characters.
